svg.aria-label: Luau reactivity benchmark results, lower is faster
svg.text: headless luau 0.737 -O2 · per-bench process isolation · normalised per row to the fastest (shorter = faster)
over 23 of 23 rows · DNF charged the 8s per-run deadline
teardown & GCdispose cost, reclaim time, and live-graph tracing time
memory60k-node graph · footprint ×leanest, retention in KB (~0 = fully released) · excluded from the overall geometric mean
Port of milomg/js-reactivity-benchmark · normalised per row to the fastest framework (1.0×, shorter = faster) · process-isolated, upstream's warm-ups and fastest-of-N (cellx: mean).
Faded bars exceed 10× (true multiple labelled) · a DNF is a run past the 8s deadline and is charged exactly that run time in the geomean on every row (an unexpected error is excluded instead).
evals = computed + effect bodies run per kairo iteration / cellx propagation / dynamic run · run-to-run noise is about ±10% even with fastest-of-N and several passes, so treat smaller gaps as ties.
